abstract: OBJECTIVE: To report the results of ovulation induction and in vitro fertilization-embryo transfer (IVF-ET) in patients with ovarian cystic teratomas. METHODS: Six women with ultrasonographically diagnosed ovarian cystic teratomas (mean diameter 2.4 cm) who presented with infertility underwent IVF-ET (n = 4) or ovulation induction (n = 2). Serial ultrasound examinations were used to determine the size of the cystic teratomas during therapy and throughout pregnancy. RESULTS: Ovarian stimulation was successful, as evidenced by the serum estradiol concentration on the day of hCG administration (mean in IVF-ET patients, 3558+/-1319 pg/mL) and the number of oocytes retrieved (10+/-4.24). Three patients having IVF-ET and both patients having ovulation induction conceived, and six healthy infants were born. Cyst sizes remained unchanged throughout treatment and pregnancy. There were no cyst-related complications during ovulation induction or IVF-ET, or during the entire course of pregnancy, labor, and delivery. CONCLUSION: The presence of ovarian cystic teratoma should not be considered a contraindication for therapy in women undergoing ovulation induction and IVF-ET.
abstract_ja: 目的：卵巣嚢胞性奇形腫を有する女性における排卵誘発および体外受精・胚移植（IVF-ET）の結果を報告すること。方法：超音波検査で卵巣嚢胞性奇形腫（平均径2.4cm）と診断され、不妊を主訴とした女性6例が、IVF-ET（4例）または排卵誘発（2例）を受けた。治療中および妊娠中の嚢胞の大きさを経時的な超音波検査で評価した。結果：卵巣刺激は成功し、ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)投与日の血清エストラジオール濃度（IVF-ET群の平均3558±1319 pg/mL）と採卵数（10±4.24個）によってそれが示された。IVF-ETを受けた患者3例と排卵誘発を受けた患者2例がすべて妊娠し、健康な乳児6名が出生した。治療および妊娠を通じて嚢胞の大きさは変化しなかった。排卵誘発、IVF-ET、妊娠・分娩の全過程において嚢胞関連の合併症はなかった。結論：卵巣嚢胞性奇形腫の存在は、排卵誘発およびIVF-ETを受ける女性にとって治療の禁忌とみなすべきではない。
